question: What is the name and essential nature of the protective armor described here?
premises: It is identified as a kavaca or protective armor.
Its nature is described as having the form of Brahman.
inference: The armor named Trailokyamaṅgala is of the nature of Brahman.
plain_english: This armor, named Trailokyamaṅgala, is of the form of Brahman.
